messages:
deploybot: Created release tag `release/v2.15.0-canary-20260319` from commit c4f3a9b. Short changelog attached below. Deploy target: canary -> us-west-2 -> prod promotion gated. Change window: 23:00-01:00 UTC tonight.

alice.k: Nice. Can you include the build artifact hash and release notes link?

deploybot: Artifact: `redwood-inference-server:sha256:7d1e2f3`. Changelog: https://go/internal/release-notes/2.15.0-canary (internal). Summary pasted: "optimize: improved KV cache evictions; runtime: faster attention kernel for 8k; fix: retry on transient kv-store errors; ops: expose batching diagnostics"

bob.m: Holding for DB migration? The config table schema v3 landed in the tag. We should pin the migration or postpone.

celeste: Migration is backward compatible. We can rollout canary with a DB-migrate job that runs post-canary. Plan: run migration job in canary only, smoke test, then prod migration with rolling windows.

alice.k: @celeste confirm the migration job command so SRE can run it during the window.

celeste: Command: ```bash
kubectl -n infra run db-migrate-2-15 --image=infra/migrator:2.15 -- /migrate --to v3
```
Notes: runs <2m, idempotent.

dave: I'll queue the usual smoke test flow. Tests: health, example-llm-inference, streaming-sanity. If smoke fails we rollback tag via `deploybot rollback release/v2.15.0-canary-20260319`.

erin: Tag pinned in private dev apps. Can we get an explicit canary percentage and duration? Recommend 5% for 30m then 20% for 30m if green.

deploybot: Canary deployment started: canary=5% in us-west-2 (instance pool: canary-gpu-small). Build hash verified.

infra-bot: Canary instances up: 4 pods. Avg p95 latency (recent 5m): 142ms. Memory usage stable. No SLO breaches.

alice.k: Good. @dave start smoke flow now. Report after 30m.

dave: Smoke run started. Logs: ```/logs/smoke/1987654322-canary.log```

(deploybot): Canary promotion decision ready after 30m. Use `/deploybot promote release/v2.15.0-canary-20260319 --to prod --policy gradual` to promote.

bob.m: If migration job succeeds on canary, we should coordinate prod migration with low traffic window + backup. I'll be on-call.

celeste: Agreed. I'll monitor migration metrics and fail early if any long tail ops appear.

erin: Adding a note to the change window calendar invite and tagging security review completed.

deploybot: Canary reached 30m. Smoke tests: PASS. No errors in logs above threshold. Proceed when ready.

alice.k: Okay go for 20% stage for next 30m.

dave: Promoting to 20% now.

infra-bot: 20% rollout in progress. New pod count: 12. p95 latency now 155ms. Error rate unchanged.

deploybot: Promotion to prod initiated at 00:05 UTC. Rolling update strategy: 10% increments with health checks. Estimated finish: 00:45 UTC.

alice.k: Pin request: ops please pin `redwood-inference-server` to `sha256:7d1e2f3` in the infra deployment repo for hotfix branches.

bob.m: Noted. I'll create a pin PR: https://go/internal/pins/PR-721.

deploybot: Release completed: `release/v2.15.0-canary-20260319` promoted to prod. Final artifact: `redwood-inference-server:sha256:7d1e2f3`. If rollback needed: `/deploybot rollback release/v2.14.3 --reason <short-reason>`.

alice.k: Thanks everyone. Adding post-release checklist items to the release ticket.

celeste: I'm running the full migration monitoring for 2 hours. Will report anomalies.

infra-bot: Post-release health: p95=160ms, error rate within baseline, examples throughput +4%. No immediate alerts.

erin: Updating release notes with rollout timeline and migration notes. Will ping product channels.

bob.m: Great. Locking the infra pin once PR merges.

alice.k: Closing this thread when PR and post-release checks are green. :white_check_mark:
